name: Mowing
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of mowing to illustrate the transient nature of life and the sovereignty of God over growth and judgment. Psalms 90:6 highlights how life flourishes in the morning but is cut down by evening, symbolizing human frailty. Psalms 72:6 portrays the coming of the Lord as refreshing rain upon mown grass, signifying restoration after judgment. Amos 7:1 and Psalms 129:7 depict the consequences of mowing, emphasizing that the mower gains no lasting benefit, pointing to God's ultimate authority in the cycles of growth and harvest.
